summary_en: BCPE Neon Cayman, L.P. completed a tender offer for baudroie shares on October 5, 2026, acquiring 10,365,448 shares. Combined with parallel purchases from founding shareholders Shigehiro Tominaga, Kazuya Fujii, and Yoshiaki Tejima, the acquirer will hold over 50% voting rights effective October 13, 2026, becoming the parent company and principal shareholder.
title_en: Notice Regarding Results of Tender Offer for Our Shares by BCPE Neon Cayman, L.P. and Changes in Parent Company, Principal Shareholders, and Principal Shareholder as Lead Shareholder
translation_en_brief:
BCPE Neon Cayman, L.P., a limited partnership organized and registered under the laws of the Cayman Islands, completed a tender offer for baudroie shares that commenced on August 19, 2026. The offer period ended on October 5, 2026. The total number of shares tendered was 10,365,448, exceeding the minimum threshold of 3,135,200 shares required for the offer to succeed. All tendered shares were acquired by the bidder.

In addition to the public tender offer, on August 18, 2026, the bidder entered into parallel purchase agreements with three founding shareholders: Shigehiro Tominaga (principal shareholder and lead shareholder), Kazuya Fujii, and Yoshiaki Tejima. These agreements stipulated that upon the success of the tender offer, each founding shareholder would transfer all of their baudroie shares to the bidder outside the tender process. Following the tender offer's success, these parallel purchases were executed.

As a result of these transactions, effective October 13, 2026 (the settlement commencement date of the tender offer), the bidder will hold more than 50% of the total voting rights in baudroie, becoming its new parent company and principal lead shareholder. BCPE Neon GP, LLC, the general partner of the bidder, will become an indirect parent company. The founding shareholders will cease to be principal shareholders or lead shareholders.
